steps: Here Finance asks a simple question: can the overnight job that classifies ten thousand tickets cost less?
Realtime calls would answer all ten thousand instantly, at full price, even though nobody is waiting. Instant answers only matter when a user is waiting.
So instead, at eight in the evening, you submit all ten thousand tickets in one batch, each tagged with a custom I D, and get back a batch I D. The batch is in progress.
Next, TicketFlow polls batches retrieve every sixty seconds, while the batch runs asynchronously for hours within its completion window.
By six in the morning, the processing status is ended. The results come back matched by custom I D, for example ticket zero, billing.
Finally, you hand Finance the cost model: the same ten thousand tickets, with every input and output token fifty percent cheaper. Half price, for work that can wait.
